docker.yml dispatched from master, its first real execution. The build step (docker compose -f deploy/local/compose.yaml build engine) fails, exit 1, at the baked RUN python -m pytest tests/ -q. ~90 tests fail with FileNotFoundError-shaped errors -- test_business_map, test_env_check, test_release_check, test_state_map, test_node_dossier, test_spine_check, test_runs, test_claims, test_obs_export, test_pipeline_cli, test_mutation, test_next_action, test_invariants, test_extras_check -- plus test_intel errors. Root cause: compose.yaml's build context for the engine service is engine/ only (context: ../../engine), so lib/, oss/, corpus/, state/, .github/workflows/, CLAUDE.md and execution_state.json never enter the image. Many engine tests intentionally read that tree (CLAUDE.md's own engine.yml comment already documents this: 'The engine's tests read outside engine/'), so Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] inside the container resolves to filesystem root rather than the repository root, and every such test fails to find its target file. Not a system-library gap (the mechanism DOCKER.md's GPU-image lessons predicted); a build-context/test-suite-scope mismatch that had never been exercised before this run.

docker.yml dispatched from the feature branch after fixing the three causes E-013 and R-0009 found: git installed in the image (apt-get install git before the baked pytest run), .git/ un-excluded from .dockerignore so real history is present, and fetch-depth: 0 on the workflow's checkout so that history is not shallow. Run 34277853648 (run_number 3, workflow_dispatch, conclusion success): the build step completed in under a minute -- apt-get installs git (2.47.3), pip install -e .[dev] resolves, and RUN python -m pytest tests/ -q passes the full 1,230-test suite from inside the container (15.4s). The image is tagged omnex-local-engine:latest (confirmed by docker inspect, not assumed) at 349489234 bytes (~333 MB) -- larger than the Dockerfile comment's un-measured '~120 MB' claim, since a repo-root build context now copies in more than the old engine/-only one did, but still far under the ~8 GB GPU-image comparison DOCKER.md draws. C-014 is SUPPORTED: the build succeeds and its baked test suite passes, measured rather than assumed.

An advanced-setup CodeQL workflow (.github/workflows/codeql.yml) was pushed and its SARIF upload was refused by GitHub's own code-scanning endpoint with 'CodeQL analyses from advanced configurations cannot be processed when the default setup is enabled', on both the javascript-typescript and python jobs. That message is GitHub's own service confirming default setup is active for this repository -- something a repository-tree scan cannot rederive, since default setup is a Settings toggle with no file. The workflow was reverted rather than kept red: GitHub refuses to run both, so an advanced-setup file here can only ever fail, gaining no analysis beyond what default setup already runs.
